issues.problem: “詹姆斯·威尔逊/James Wilson”中的名“詹姆斯/James”不见于证据。证据只称 Mr. Wilson。

evidence.quote: which Mr. Wilson read in the words following

issues.problem: “不少人心知有缺点/Many in the room knew the document had flaws”写的是众人的内心认知。证据只记录了个别成员公开表示的异议。

evidence.quote: he too had objections
who may still have objections to it

issues.proposed: 改为“会上不少人公开表示过保留”/“Several members had voiced objections”。

issues.problem: “问题只剩一个：签不签，怎么签/One question was left”与证据不符。同日会议还通过了戈勒姆的修正案，并表决了会议记录的处置。

evidence.quote: might be yet reconsidered, in order to strike out "forty thousand," and insert "thirty thousand."
A question was then put on depositing the Journals

issues.proposed: 改为“最后的焦点是：签不签、怎么签”/“The central question was: sign it or not, and how.”

issues.problem: “到这里，争的已经不是文本好不好，而是手上有没有更好的东西可拿/By now the argument was not about...”是作者的概括，却写成了当日实况，没有标明是解释。
issues.proposed: 前加“作者认为”/“On one reading,”。

issues.problem: “于是当天真正的争点浮出水面/So the day's real dispute came into view”用因果连接，并断定何为“真正的争点”。这是作者的判断，未标为解释。
issues.proposed: 删“于是/So”，改为“作者认为，当天的一个核心争点是……”/“One reading is that a central dispute was...”。

issues.problem: “他要的不是人人说好，而是名字出现在同一份文件上”（英文另有“one small thing”“Note the ask”）是对富兰克林意图的界定，未标为作者解释。证据只记录了他的请求本身。

evidence.quote: to make manifest our unanimity, put his name to this instrument

issues.proposed: 改为“一种解释是，他要的不是……”/“One reading: not that...”；删“one small thing”。

issues.problem: 英文写了该条款“had produced so much discussion”，中文缺这一点。

evidence.quote: which had produced so much discussion

issues.proposed: 中文补“（该条款曾引起许多讨论）”。

issues.problem: 英文把麦迪逊的第三人称转述“He meant only to keep himself free...”放进引号，接在“he said”之后，读来像伦道夫的原话。

evidence.quote: He meant only to keep himself free to be governed by his duty, as it should be prescribed by his future judgment.

issues.proposed: 去掉引号改为转述，或写明“in Madison's words”。

issues.problem: 汉密尔顿一句，英文有“might do infinite mischief”和“an enthusiasm…which might soon subside”，中文都缺。

evidence.quote: might do infinite mischief, by kindling the latent sparks that lurk under an enthusiasm in favor of the Convention which may soon subside

issues.proposed: 中文补“可能造成无穷祸害”“潜藏在可能很快消退的拥护热情之下的火星”。

issues.problem: 中英文都截去了“from the refusal of individuals to sign it”。原文的意思是：人们担心的无政府与内乱本来被归因于个别人拒签，伦道夫反指“全收或全拒”的方式才会导致这种结果。截断后这一对照丢失。

evidence.quote: would really produce the anarchy and civil convulsions which were apprehended from the refusal of individuals to sign it

issues.proposed: 补“（人们原以为个别人拒签才会招致的）”/“that were apprehended from the refusal of individuals to sign it”。

issues.problem: 中英不对称：中文缺“painful feelings”（痛苦心情）；英文缺两派相撞、混乱可忧一句。

evidence.quote: described the painful feelings of his situation
From the collision of these, in opposing and resisting the Constitution, confusion was greatly to be feared.

issues.proposed: 中文补“讲了自己处境的痛苦”；英文补“from the collision of the two, in resisting the Constitution, confusion was greatly to be feared”。

issues.problem: 英文“Franklin's reply was light in tone but decisive”描述语气与效果，证据没有记载，中文也没有对应内容。
“那正是当天有人最想要的东西/wanted most”断言了程度。证据只显示有人希望人人签名、显示一致，并没有说这是他们“最想要”的。

evidence.quote: expressed his anxiety that every member should sign
to make manifest our unanimity

issues.proposed: 改为“而那正是当天有人力求的东西”/“the unanimity some in the room were pressing for”。

issues.problem: 现代虚构场景直接引用了证据中富兰克林的原话，违反现代段不得引证据的规则。文中还称这句话“提供了”“记进纪要”的做法，但原句只讲意见留在墙内、从未外传。
issues.proposed: 删去引语和“、记进纪要”，改为不引史料的现代表述，如“会内把反对讲透，出了门不再外传”。

issues.problem: “是一位与会者写下的记录/a participant's record”：证据没有说明麦迪逊是与会者。
issues.proposed: 删去该说法，或改为“麦迪逊的会议笔记”。

issues.problem: 同F15，“一位与会者的记录/a participant's account”证据无据。
issues.proposed: 删去“一位与会者的记录/a participant's account”。

issues.problem: 中文“威尔逊反对销毁”言过其实，也与英文“prefers the second course”不一致。证据只说他倾向第二种办法，且曾一度更赞成销毁。

evidence.quote: Mr. WILSON preferred the second expedient. He had at one time liked the first best

issues.proposed: 改为“威尔逊倾向交主席保管（他一度更赞成销毁）”。

issues.problem: 中文“听候依宪法成立的国会处置”丢掉了原文的条件“if ever formed”，与英文不一致。

evidence.quote: subject to the order of Congress, if ever formed under the Constitution

issues.proposed: 改为“听候日后若依宪法成立的国会处置”。

issues.problem: “未替任何人补写动机或心理/no motive or psychology has been supplied”与正文不符：正文含有“不少人心知有缺点”（F2）、对富兰克林意图的界定（F6）、“light in tone but decisive”（F12）。
issues.proposed: 按F2、F6、F12修正文；若不改，则删去这句保证。

inherited.rationale: 同日还有修正案表决与会议记录处置，“只剩一个”不成立。

evidence.quote: No opposition was made to the proposition of Mr. Gorham, and it was agreed to unanimously.

inherited.rationale: 原句只说意见留在墙内消亡，并无“记进纪要”。现代段还不应引用证据。

evidence.quote: Within these walls they were born, and here they shall die.

inherited.rationale: 证据只作 Mr. Wilson，没有名“詹姆斯”。

evidence.quote: Mr. Wilson read

inherited.rationale: “心知”是内心状态，证据只记录公开的异议。
属于作者概括，却未标为解释。

evidence.quote: Within these walls they were born, and here they shall die.

inherited.rationale: 证据没有说明麦迪逊是与会者。uncertainty_note 中的同类说法见F16。
